title: Rey
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: After finding some semblance of a family in the Resistance and trained in the ways of the Jedi by General Leia Organa, Rey was a prominent leader who yearned to defeat the evil in the galaxy. As the granddaughter of the Emperor, Sheev Palpatine, she decided to choose her own path and once she defeated his evil took the name Skywalker to spread hope thoughout the galaxy.
